Question Choices: Solve the system using substitution: y = 3x + 1 and x + y = 13. What is the value of x?
Hints: Replace one variable with its equivalent expression, then solve and substitute back.
Solution: System: y=3 × x+1; x+y=13. Isolate y: y=(3)x+(1). Substitute into the other equation: (1)x+(1)[(3)x+(1)]=13. Combine: (4)x=12, so x=3. Then y=(3)(3)+(1)=10. Check both equations: -3(3)+1(10)=1; 1(3)+1(10)=13. Requested answer: 3.
